incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-87321 — inference-east: 5xx spike and request queue growth > 95th percentile. Auto-escalation enabled. <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-87321|view>
maya: acked. i'll grab this — heading to the bridge. starting with runbook: 'inference-high-5xx'.
owen: on my way too. paging history shows a gradual ramp since 16:02 UTC.
incident-bot: summary: error-rate 5xx from 0.6% -> 9.8% in 12m, avg latency +220ms, kvcache evictions spike. sample hosts: gpu-04, gpu-07.
pagerbot: claim by @sre-rotation via pagerbot UI.
sre-rotation: claimed. creating bridge: https://meet.company/bridge/PD-87321
lina: quick note — customer A reported failures in prod chat flows. flagged severity: customer-impacting.
maya: running quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference-east -o wide | grep CrashLoop` — looks like qcache pods healthy, queue-proxy shows 30% CPU on gpu-04.
maya: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T16:14:03Z inference-runtime ERROR request_handler.cpp:412 Tokenization failed: OOM
2026-03-17T16:14:08Z kvcache WARNING eviction count=1247
``` 
owen: possible culprit: recent autoscaler rule change from 500->750 concurrent that hasn't propagated to dedicated pool; also seeing spooler backlog.
incident-bot: recommended actions (runbook): 1) scale inference-deploy to +2 replicas for short window, 2) drain gpu-04, 3) enable fallback to replica-model-v2.
sre-rotation: doing step 1 now: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-deploy --replicas=6 -n inference-east` — ETA ~45s.
maya: step 2 scheduled: cordon gpu-04 and shift traffic. running `fluxctl` shift.
lina: notifying support & CSM: "Investigating increased errors, mitigation in progress; will update in 10m" :email:
pagerbot: PD incident status: acknowledged -> `in_progress` by sre-rotation.
owen: monitoring metrics dashboard: queue latency decreasing after scale. will watch request success rate and token errors.
sre-rotation: handoff plan: i'll own the mitigation for the next 30m, then pass to @maya for 2h observation and postmortem notes. if error rate falls under 1% for 15m, we'll begin rollback.
maya: noted. collecting eval prompts to run quality checks post-fallback.
incident-bot: timeline log entry: 16:12 UTC alert, 16:13 ack, 16:15 scale triggered, 16:17 cordon start, 16:21 fallback model enabled.
owen: customer-impact update: customer A experiencing degradations for ~9m prior to our ack. support escalated to SE team.
lina: adding to ticket PD-87321: customer-impact=true; severity=high.
sre-rotation: will post a brief postmortem draft after stabilization. any objections to keeping dedicated pool autoscaler rule change on hold until root cause determined?
maya: no objections. agree to freeze that config until postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: reminder: next ping in 10m unless status changes. :timer_clock:
